description: Blind plain-language set. Written after the map was widened, and measured once. Do not tune the map against these cases: that would make this set a development set too.

cases.q: My landlord locked me out of the flat while I was at work
Police stopped me on the road and asked me for money
My company stopped paying my pension contributions
Someone registered a company in my name without my knowledge
My husband beats me when he is drunk
Debt collectors keep calling me at night and threatening me
My insurance company refuses to pay my claim after my car was stolen
The school is holding my daughter's result because of unpaid fees
My neighbour makes loud noise all night and I cannot sleep
My landlord keeps raising the rent without any notice
A customer posted lies about my business online
My son was arrested and nobody told me where they took him
My tenant has not paid rent for six months and refuses to leave
My employer deducted money from my salary without telling me
My wife took our children abroad without my consent
A landlord wants me to pay a huge sum before he will sign the agreement
